يضطهد (form VIII)
# يَضْطَهِدُ (yaḍṭahidu) /jadˤ.tˤa.hi.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# يُضْطَهَدُ (yuḍṭahadu) /judˤ.tˤa.ha.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# يَضْطَهِدَ (yaḍṭahida) /jadˤ.tˤa.hi.da/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
